question: Which of the following Constitutional Amendment incorporated Dadra, Nagar and Haveli in the Union of India as a Union Territory?
solution:
The correct answer is **__10th.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Tenth Amendment of the Constitution of India,

 
 
• 1**0th amendment of the Indian Constitution incorporated Dadra and Nagar Haveli **as the seventh Union territory of India, by amending the First Schedule to the Constitution
 
 
 
• **Constitution (Twelfth Amendment) Act, 1962**.
 
 
• This amendment** integrated Goa, Daman, and Diu as India's eighth Union territory.** It also included these areas under clause (1) of Article 240 of the Constitution.
 
• India acquired control of Goa, Daman, and Diu from Portugal in December 1961​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Nineteenth Amendment** of the Constitution of India, officially known as The Constitution (Nineteenth Amendment) Act, 1966, **abolished Election Tribunals in India and enabled the trial of election petitions by High Courts**.
 
• The **14th Amendment** to the U.S. Constitution, ratified in 1868, **granted citizenship to all persons born or naturalized in the United States—including formerly enslaved people—and guaranteed all citizens “equal protection of the laws.”**
